items.name: Router Mini
items.fits: Standard 4, Standard 4 X, Mini, Gen 2 kits (not Gen 1)
items.specs: Wi-Fi 6, dual-band; coverage up to 112 m² (1,200 ft²); 1 latching Ethernet LAN port (Starlink Plug); 137 × 84 × 25 mm; removable stand doubles as a wall mount; separate power supply 100–240 V; works as the primary router or as a mesh node with Router 3, Gen 2 and Mini routers. The router shipped in the Standard 4 kit.

items.name: Roof Rack Mount | Standard 4 or 4 X
match: Roof Rack Mount | Standard 4 or 4 X
items.specs: Clamps to vehicle roof-rack crossbars 15–44.5 mm thick and up to 95 mm wide, or to T-slot racks; quick to detach when not in use; for use while parked.

items.name: Standard 4 or 4 X to Standard Actuated Mount Adapter
match: Standard 4 or 4 X to Standard Actuated Mount Adapter
items.fits: Standard 4 / 4 X dish onto an existing Standard Actuated (Gen 2) mount
items.specs: Lets a new Standard 4 / 4 X dish use a mount already installed for the older Standard Actuated dish, without replacing the mount: Short Wall Mount, Long Wall Mount, Pivot Mount, Ground Pole Mount, Ridgeline Mount. Mast and hardware included. For customers upgrading a Gen 2 dish.

items.name: X-Frame Base | Standard 4 or 4 X, Enterprise
match: X-Frame Base | Standard 4 or 4 X, Enterprise
items.specs: Folding X-shaped base for a ground-level installation or a quick set-up, holding the dish slightly off the ground; no drilling.

items.name: Ridgeline Mount | Standard 4 or 4 X
items.specs: Non-penetrating roof mount: adjustable legs straddle the roof ridge or lie flat on a flat roof, no holes drilled; held down by four ballast weights of about 5 kg each (kit also has cable routing clips); rated to 80 km/h wind; for shingle and metal roofs, not recommended for clay tile. Heavy to ship.

items.name: Router 3 Mount
items.specs: Bracket to fix the Router 3 to a wall or other surface.

items.name: Mobility Mount | Standard 4 or 4 X
items.specs: Permanent mount for vehicles, boats and cabins: forms a watertight seal on wood, fibreglass, metal, plastic and slotted rack rails; fixed 8° tilt; for use while parked.

items.name: Power Supply Mount | Standard 4 X
items.specs: Bracket to fix the Standard 4 X dish power supply (the separate brick) to a wall. Not for the Standard 4 dual-port supply.

items.name: Pivot Mount | Standard 4 and 4 X, Enterprise
match: Pivot Mount | Standard 4 and 4 X, Enterprise
items.specs: For slanted, shingled roofs; swivelling head for fine adjustment of angle and direction. Kit: pivot mount, 20 routing clips, 2 lag screws, silicone sealant, sealing tape.

items.name: Wall Mount | Standard 4 or 4 X
items.specs: Exterior wall mount that holds the dish clear of the wall and eaves. Kit: wall mount, 20 routing clips, 2 lag screws, silicone sealant.

items.name: Pipe Adapter | Standard 4 or 4 X
items.specs: Fits the dish to an existing metal pole of 31–63.5 mm (1.25–2.5 in) diameter; metal pipes only, not PVC; hardware included. The usual part for a pole installation.

items.name: Router 3 | Starlink V4 or V5, Mini
match: Router 3 | Starlink V4 or V5, Mini
items.fits: Standard 4, Standard 4 X, Mini, Gen 2 and Gen 3 kits
items.specs: Tri-band Wi-Fi 6; coverage up to 297 m² (3,200 ft²); 2 latching Ethernet LAN ports; up to 235 devices; IP56; WPA2; 300 × 120 × 55 mm, about 1 kg; separate power supply 100–240 V; primary router or mesh node. The router shipped in the Standard 4 X kit.

items.name: Travel Kit | Mini
items.specs: Protects the Mini on the move: a custom-fitted Bumper Case for drop protection, a Sleeve that doubles as a carrying case and shields against dirt, scrapes and bumps, and an Accessory Pouch that holds everything needed to power the Mini.

items.name: Car Adapter | Mini
items.specs: Powers the Mini from a vehicle's 12–24 V auxiliary (cigarette-lighter) socket over USB-C, in place of the Mini power supply and DC cable. Pair with the 5 m USB-C cable for reach from socket to dish.

items.name: Starlink Mini USB-C Cable 5m
items.specs: 5 m USB-C cable to power the Mini from a USB-C Power Delivery source: the Car Adapter or a power bank. Starlink's guidance is a PD source of at least 65 W, 100 W recommended, for full performance.

items.name: Mobility Mount | Mini
items.specs: Permanent vehicle or boat installation for the Mini; bolted down with a sealed footprint, for use while parked.

items.name: Roof Rack Mount | Mini
items.specs: Removable installation of the Mini on vehicle roof-rack crossbars; clamps on and comes off when not in use; for use while parked.

items.name: Starlink Mini Ethernet Cable 15m
items.fits: Mini, Performance (Gen 3) dish → Router 3 or a third-party router
items.specs: 15 m Ethernet run from the Mini (or the Performance Gen 3 dish) to a Router 3 or any third-party router, with a weather-sealed latching plug on the dish end and standard RJ45 at the router. This is how a Mini feeds a Router 3 for a bigger house.

items.name: Pivot Mount | Mini
items.specs: For slanted roofs; swivelling head for fine adjustment of angle and direction.

items.name: Wall Mount | Mini
items.specs: Exterior wall installation for the Mini; clears an eave overhang of up to about 10 cm (4 in).

items.name: Starlink Mini Kit
items.specs: Compact all-in-one dish with the Wi-Fi router built in; kickstand, pipe adapter, power supply and cable in the box. Powered from mains, a vehicle or a USB-C power bank.

items.name: Starlink Standard Kit
items.specs: The Standard dish with its router (Router Mini in the Standard 4 kit, Router 3 in the Standard 4 X kit), power supply, 15 m Starlink cable and kickstand. The dish every mount on this page marked Standard 4 or 4 X is made for.
